newsitem.title: USA: ITT Hartford gets Firemans Fund reinsurance rights.
newsitem.headline: ITT Hartford gets Firemans Fund reinsurance rights.

text.p: ITT Hartford Group Inc has agreed to acquire the renewal rights to all of San Francisco Re 's property-casualty reinsurance business, ITT Hartford said on Friday.

San Francisco Re, the reinsurance division of Allianz AG Holding's unit Fireman's Fund Insurance Co in Novato, Calif., generates more than $100 million in annual premium, it said. Reinsurance is insurance that insurance companies buy to reduce their exposure to large claims.
Financial details of the deal, which is expected to be completed by October 30, were not disclosed.

On November 1, ITT Hartford will begin renewing San Francisco Re's reinsurance contracts. It expects to renew most of these contracts and plans to operate and service this business out of San Francisco, where it will open an office within the next few weeks.
"We are pleased to have completed an arrangement to place the San Francisco Re renewals with The Hartford," said Joe Stinnette, president and chief executive of Fireman's Fund.
"Our action allows Fireman's Fund to exit the reinsurance marketplace and to focus on our core insurance business for commercial, personal and specialty lines," he said.
